<!--
This file is the GitHub pull-request description, not the git commit.
Keep commit and merge messages to a short subject plus a few sentences.
Do not copy this template, HTML, checklists, or agent UI into git history.
-->

## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe what a user could not do and what this change enables. Link an issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the exact checks run and their results. For interactions, include browser/OS and the gestures tested. For physics or engine changes, include numerical evidence and assumptions. State anything not tested.

## Compatibility and scope

Does this change saved documents, IDs, port contracts, numerical behavior, or dependencies? Explain migrations and retained upstream notices when relevant. Mention material AI assistance if it helps review; do not include private transcripts.

- [ ] I reviewed the diff and kept unrelated work and generated local artifacts out.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation or explained why no update is needed.
- [ ] Any screenshots, fixtures, and diagnostics use shareable synthetic data.
